'''Hammer''' is a warhorse.

==Appearance==
Hammer is a tall, bay gelding. He is powerful, sleek and fast.

==Activities==
Hammer carries [[Tervail Dura]] to [[Tar Valon]] and the [[White Tower]] through a [[gateway]] from the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] camp. Both Tervail and [[Beonin Marinye]], riding [[Winterfinch]], were sneaking back to the Tower after [[Egwene al'Vere]] had been captured.{{ref/book|11|2}}
